en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of fantasies
does Kaede think about...?

<CLT=cltMIND>This is getting awkward...
What am I supposed to do...?
Do you remember what today is?

So you don't remember...
I kinda had that feeling.

No, you don't need to apologize.
My friends told me boys are like this.

<CLT=cltMIND>She put her hands on her hips
and pouted at me.

Today...is our anniversary.
You know, when we started dating...

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I see...this is Kaede's fantasy.
That must be why she's talking like this...

Since it's our anniversary...
I want you to say it, Shuichi...

U-Um... God, Shuichi!
I was the one who confessed to you, you know!

I-I'm sorry, Kaede, but I honestly
don't know what you want me to say...
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh no, did I make her mad again?

How long will I have to wait before you call
me something other than just Kaede?

I...I'm not...okay...
Hearing that took me by surprise.
But...you went back to calling me Kaede again.

Geez! Don't get all quiet on me!
I'm super embarrassed now!

<CLT=cltMIND>Without a word of warning, the
blushing Kaede took me in her arms.

<CLT=cltMIND>As Kaede leaned into me,
I lost my balance, and...

<CLT=cltMIND>When I opened my eyes...I found Kaede in
my lap, both of us sitting on the bed.

Ah! K-Kaede, sorry, this is a bit...
Ah...

<CLT=cltMIND>We're...in bed...
Ah, not like I would try anything!

<CLT=cltMIND>She whispered in my ear and
squeezed me tighter.

<CLT=cltMIND>Slowly, I put my arms around her,
pulling her in gently.

<CLT=cltMIND>Matching my movements, she drew her
body closer, pressing herself against me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede's warmth was speaking to me...
and my whole body was listening.

I can hear yours too, Shuichi.
It's my favorite melody.

It envelops me in a warm, strong embrace...
more than any other song can do.

Shuichi, you play my heart better 
than I play the piano.

If we're going to be honest today, then...
I wanted to hear you say that...

As long as you give me this courage,
I can do anything. Aah, what should I do...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede— Ah, I mean, my sweetheart...
pulled back and rested herself on my lap.

<CLT=cltMIND>We stared into each other's eyes for a
long while...our noses almost touching...

Shuichi, will you...do it with me?
I would like that more than anything.

<CLT=cltMIND>In place of a reply,
I pulled her in closer...
